Plans/Section15_MVP_Promoted_Features_Spec.md#section=Terminal record wire contract “When a record leaves the engine it is one JSON object (RFC 8259, UTF-8) with exactly the record's minimum fields plus `record_type`, a constant equal to the record name, and `schema_version`, the constant `"1.0.0"`. The row set covers TerminalIngestionReceipt, TerminalBackpressureState, TerminalInputEvent, TerminalPasteReceipt, TerminalOscEvent, TerminalProfileResolution, TerminalSessionRestoreDecision and TerminalDiagnosticsEnvelope with typed fields and diagnostic-bundle eligibility. TerminalRenderFrame is web-transport only. TerminalScrollbackAnchor is for agent reads or the web transport. TerminalAccessibilitySnapshot is for the accessibility bridge or the web transport. TerminalDiagnosticsEnvelope also has a FileSafe log route.
